name: classify
assumes: a net in the design other than NC, which a trace never crosses
role start is the net query_xnet_by_net_name names, or the net under the pin query_xnet_by_pin_name names; role reached is a net a trace arrives at through a series passive

name ground is a ground token with letters and digits only (GND, GND1, GNDREF, AGND, VSS); separated_ground starts with a ground token and has a separator (GND_SW); power is a power rail name (VCC_3V3, 3V3); signal is anything else

pin ground_pin is a pin whose function name is a ground by the same rule (GND, GND1, PGND); supply_pin is VCC or VDD with letters and digits (AVDD, VDDIO) or VBAT, VBATT, VBUS, VSYS with at most digits after
size over_40 means more than 40 pins on the net
